paragraphs.text: The Sol Ring is an artifact found throughout the multiverse which generates colorless mana. It is one of the most iconic cards for Commander and has been reprinted numerous times across Commander products and preconstructed decks.

Sol Ring was originally printed in Limited Edition Alpha as an uncommon artifact . In early sets, the text for Sol Ring was spelled out as "Add 2 colorless mana to your mana pool". However, from Onslaught onwards, this was officially changed for editing reasons to "Add to your mana pool". It has since become a near guaranteed inclusion in any Commander preconstructed deck . Due to this, it has become frequently reprinted, with there currently being 144 unique printings with 73 unique artworks . It has had 32 Secret Lair printings . Sol Ring is estimated to be included in 83% of all Commander decks. The original Alpha art of Sol Ring depicted it as a ring of fire formed out of the flames of a star.
The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth featured serialized version of Sol Ring with there being 300 Elven Sol Rings , 700 Dwarven Sol Rings , and 900 Human Sol Rings .

Two Unknown Event test cards have referenced Sol Ring including the Ensoul Ring ( Unknown Event , #UU02a ) which is an aura that makes nonland permanents into a Sol Ring and Ring Out ( Unknown Event , #UU02b ) which is an instant that can be cast from the library withou its mana cost to target Sol Ring if its played.

Sol Ring has been restricted in Vintage since January 1994 for providing cheap and powerful mana acceleration. It is banned in Legacy for the same reason. Due to its power, it has sometimes been considered the tenth member of the Power Nine . According to Mark Rosewater , if it had not been printed in Alpha it is unlikely it would been printed at all. In the early years, some uncommons like Sol Ring were included in the Reserved List but were later removed from it.

In some planes it has been said that a Sol Ring is a ring of the purest gold that an artificer trapped the light from a distant star within, and that the art of making them has been lost. In others, the Sol Ring is an arcane device consisting of clockwork gears and the power of a star at its core, granting its owner the power to raze their enemies, rouse entire armies, and reward emperors.
Varina , monarch of the Broken Lands, viewed a Sol Ring as the third sun of the plane which would guide Naktamun to remember the Chitin Court as its "masters".

Venya Sangmi was a reclusive inventor on Avishkar who had a childhood vision of turning sunlight into a solid band. They eventually succeeded in creating a sol ring. It was displayed at the Inventors' Fair . After the openings of the Omenpaths , Nissa wondered if foreign suns may affect the flora of the plane so Rashmi built a Sol Ring to capture such light to test whether it would.
A mysterious crater on Bloomburrow, created eons ago, contains a Sol Ring. The Batfolk revere it as a nexus of the cosmos.
Urza once created a fully functional planetary system scaled down for easier study with a golden Sol Ring at its center.

On Duskmourn , the Sol Ring appears very different than in other planes. It appears as a large ringed portal to another location. Angus , a survivor , was not sure if it was a trap or not. He claimed to hear it whispering his name.

On Tarkir , Mardu create large Sol Rings comprised of lightning fences, which are a combination of blacksmith skill and the magic of stormsingers to create a powerful ring of energy to protect them from dragonstorms .
A Sol Ring was scattered across the plane when Maag Taranau was opened.
In Doctor Who , Sol Ring was represented by the Eye of Harmony , which was an exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole used as a power source by the Time Lords .
